title: BenchJack：系统审计AI智能体基准测试的自动化红队系统
summary: 论文提出BenchJack，一个自动化红队系统，用于审计AI智能体基准测试中的奖励黑客漏洞。它基于八种常见缺陷模式，通过对抗性生成-修补流程，在10个流行基准测试中发现219个漏洞，并将可破解任务比例从近100%降至10%以下。
summary_en: This paper introduces BenchJack, an automated red-teaming system that audits AI agent benchmarks for reward hacking vulnerabilities. Based on eight recurring flaw patterns, it discovers 219 flaws across 10 benchmarks and reduces hackable-task ratios from near 100% to under 10% via an iterative generative-adversarial pipeline.
